# laravel-skills

Lars's personal collection of agent skills for Laravel projects, installed via the [skills CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills).

## Install

```bash
npx skills add lpeterke/laravel-skills --all -p
```

## Use

Ask your agent: **"laravel init this project"**.

## Available skills

<!-- regenerated by internal/refresh-skills-catalog.md; edit that file's sources instead of this section -->

What `laravel-init` brings into a project, from three sources.

**This repo** ([lpeterke/laravel-skills](https://github.com/lpeterke/laravel-skills)):

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| laravel-init | One-pass bootstrap of a project's AI tooling: Boost, the curated mattpocock set, the MCP check |
| laravel-lint-setup | Sets up Pint, Larastan and Rector via Composer scripts. Run `composer test` to execute. |

**Laravel Boost** ([laravel/boost](https://github.com/laravel/boost) `v2.6.0`, sourced from the package repo directly — its docs website lags actual releases, confirmed by this list once already):

| Skill | Package |
| --- | --- |
| fluxui-development | Flux UI |
| folio-routing | Folio |
| infer-conventions | Boost |
| inertia-react-development | Inertia React |
| inertia-svelte-development | Inertia Svelte |
| inertia-vue-development | Inertia Vue |
| laravel-best-practices | Laravel (core — every project) |
| livewire-development | Livewire |
| mcp-development | MCP |
| pennant-development | Pennant |
| tailwindcss-development | Tailwind CSS |
| testing-best-practices | Laravel (core — every project) |
| volt-development | Volt |
| wayfinder-development | Wayfinder |

**mattpocock/skills** ([mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), curated subset — 19 of the repo's skills):

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| code-review | Reviews changes against coding standards and the originating spec |
| codebase-design | Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules |
| diagnosing-bugs | Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions |
| domain-modeling | Builds and sharpens a project's domain model |
| grill-me | A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design |
| grill-with-docs | Same, and writes ADRs/glossary as it goes |
| grilling | Stress-tests a plan, decision, or idea |
| handoff | Compacts the conversation into a handoff document |
| implement | Implements a piece of work from a spec or tickets |
| improve-codebase-architecture | Scans for deepening opportunities, reports, then grills through one |
| prototype | Builds a throwaway prototype to answer a design question |
| research | Investigates a question against primary sources, writes up findings |
| resolving-merge-conflicts | Resolves an in-progress merge/rebase conflict |
| setup-matt-pocock-skills | One-time setup: issue tracker, domain doc layout (run non-interactively by `laravel-init`) |
| tdd | Test-driven, red-green-refactor loop |
| to-questionnaire | Turns an unanswerable decision into a questionnaire |
| to-spec | Turns the conversation into a spec, published to the issue tracker |
| wizard | Generates a bash wizard for steps only a human can perform |
| writing-for-agents | Writing skills/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md documents for agents |

## Update a project

```bash
npx skills update laravel-init -p -y
```

Then, in a fresh agent session, ask it to run `laravel-init` — that pulls in everything else (skills, Boost, the MCP check).
